Securitize provides a platform for issuing and managing tokenized securities. Securitize operates as a regulated broker-dealer and transfer agent in the United States. Securitize applies investor onboarding and compliance checks to its tokenized offerings.

Ondo focuses on tokenizing real-world assets such as United States Treasury securities. Ondo offers tokenized yield-bearing products aimed at institutional and qualified investors.

Chainlink operates as a decentralized oracle network that supplies external data to smart contracts. Chainlink relies on multiple independent node operators to deliver data. Chainlink offers a cross-chain interoperability protocol for transferring messages and tokens between blockchains. Chainlink uses the LINK token as its native token.

Jupiter operates as a decentralized exchange aggregator on the Solana blockchain. Jupiter routes token swaps across multiple liquidity sources to find favorable prices. Jupiter also offers additional trading services such as perpetual futures.
